subject: Competitive bake-off recap: Omniva vendor comparison
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@omniva.com>, Devon Clark <devon.clark@omniva.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap: Omniva vendor comparison

Hi Sarah / Devon —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of the key points and next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Pain points you called out:
- Inference latency spikes during peak routing (customer-facing chat) causing degraded UX.
- Unpredictable per-token costs across bursty workloads (billing pressure).
- Security/compliance: need SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, and VPC isolation for production data.

Goals / decision criteria you outlined:
1) 95th percentile tail latency under 300ms (for conversational flows).
2) Predictable monthly unit costs with clear savings levers (batching / KV cache).
3) Security posture: SOC 2 + KMS integration + tenant isolation.
4) Easy rollout + rollback during pilot (canary/A-B).

Competitive landscape (as discussed):
- Redwood Inference (us): production-first runtime, smart routing, caching, and dedicated/private deployment options.
- CloudAI: strong managed endpoints but higher cost on bursty workloads.
- SelfHost Solutions: good cost on long-term steady workloads but heavy ops burden.

Open questions for bake-off / tests:
- Can you provide a representative sample workload (chat logs + typical prompt sizes)?
- Which scenarios should we prioritize for tail latency vs throughput testing?
- Any non-negotiable compliance items beyond SOC 2 (e.g., specific retention windows)?

Proposed next steps (attached MPA + benchmark ask):
1) You share a 2–3 day sample trace (anonymized) for us to run the latency/cost benchmark.
2) Redwood runs a 48-hour benchmark comparing: latency (p95/p99), tokens/sec, and $/1000 tokens across our hosted and a dedicated config.
3) Security: we’ll provide SOC 2 docs + the security questionnaire (attached PDF).
4) Align on pilot scope and signature of MPA to lock in dates.

Tentative timeline: share sample workload by Thu (7/1) -> benchmark complete by Fri (7/2) -> debrief early next week.

Attachments: 20270630-mutual_action_plan.xlsx, 20270630-benchmark-ask.md, omniva-security-questions.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
From: Devon Clark <devon.clark@omniva.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@omniva.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 18:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap: Omniva vendor comparison

Marissa — great summary, thanks. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Priority: latency is the gating criteria for the first phase. If p99 is low but p95 is within 200-300ms we're happy; p99 needs to be reasonable for tail-sensitive flows.
2) Security: SOC 2 is required; in addition we have a separate legal ask around data-retention policy (12 months default, longer for archived data).
3) SLA numbers — can you provide expected uptime/SLOs and credits for missed SLOs?

We’ll share an anonymized 48-hour trace (chat sessions + prompt sizes) by tomorrow noon. Also looped in security@omniva.com for any technical Qs.

Thanks,
Devon
Head of Product Operations | Omniva Logistics
devon.clark@omniva.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Devon Clark <devon.clark@omniva.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@omniva.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap: Omniva vendor comparison

Thanks Devon — this is helpful. Confirming a few follow-ups on our side: 

- SLA/SLOs: Redwood Dedicated offers a 99.9% uptime SLA with SLA credits; I’ve included the standard SLO doc link in the attachments and will surface exact credit tables in the benchmark results deck.
- Retention: we can support a default 12-month retention with options for extended archival. We’ll document retention/archival controls in the security pack.
- Benchmark plan: Rishi (cc’d) will own the benchmark runs and provide a comparison report (p95/p99, cost $/1k tokens, throughput).

Proposed test matrix (short):
- Scenario A: Conversational burst (short prompts, high re-query) — measure p95/p99 and token cost.
- Scenario B: Long-form summarization (long context) — measure memory/KV effects and cost.

If that looks good I’ll confirm the benchmark window for Fri (7/2) and share test endpoints + sample harness.

Best,
Marissa

- Rishi: you’ll own the benchmark runs (scenarios A/B), instrumentation, and the comparison deck (deliverable: p95/p99, throughput, $/1k tokens, and perf/cost tradeoffs). Target: draft deck by EOD Fri (7/2).
- Aditya: please prepare a short security pack (SOC 2 summary, retention details, KMS integration notes) and the MPA skeleton for signature.
- I’ll coordinate logistics with Omniva (test endpoints, harness, and timeline).

Attachments referenced earlier are in the shared drive (https://drive.company/shared/omniva-bakeoff-plan). Let me know if any blockers.
